questions.question:
Read the given statement(s) and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statement(s).

**Statements:**

Some floors are plates.

No plate is a sofa.

All gardens are plates.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some floors being gardens is a possibility.

II. No garden is a sofa.

III. All plates are gardens.

IV. No floors is a sofa.

options.text: Only Conclusions I, II and IV follow
Only Conclusions II and III follow
Only Conclusions I and II follow

questions.solution:
Statements:

Some floors are plates.

No plate is a sofa.

All gardens are plates.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/587edc04c78de53d666f2aade002301cd4f4a57b11c2966d5f770ddd42f45ca3.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Some floors being gardens is a possibility → **True (**From the given statements 'Some floors are plates.' & 'All gardens are plates..' which means Some floors being gardens is a possibility, because venn diagram of Floors and Garden may intersect , so the conclusion follow.)

II. No garden is a sofa → **True (**From the given statements 'No plate is a sofa..' & 'All gardens are plates', which means No garden is a sofa, so the conclusion follow).

III. All plates are gardens → **False (**From the given statements 'Some floors are plates.' & 'All gardens are plates..' Here Garden is subset of plate so All plates are gardens is a possibility but not necessity so the conclusion does not follow.)

IV. No floors is a sofa → **False** ( From the given statements 'No plate is a sofa..' & 'All gardens are plates', which means No floors is a sofa is a possibility, so the conclusion does not follow.)

Hence, **Only Conclusions I and II follow.**

questions.question: If A ÷ B means that A is the brother of B, A × B means that A is the sister of B, A – B means that A is the father of B then which of the following expression shows that P is the father of R?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cc18661538b8e760eee8089ba610d654eec8f61da9a77c27517f531b78869fe6.png] 

**Given :**

 
 

 Code
 Meaning
 
 

 A ÷ B
 A is the brother of B
 
 

 A × B
 A is the sister of B
 
 

 A – B
 A is the father of B
 
 

**Given Statement:** P is the father of R.

**Option 1**: P – Q × R

P – Q means ‘P is the father of Q’.

Q × R means ‘Q is the sister of R’

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a6a65b455ba77be6452968de8fb3d9736135d37e8f6f9ccd1de42a1ae0c91746.png] 

Here, P is the father of R so it will be answer.

**Option 2 :** P × Q – R

P × Q means ‘P is the sister of Q’.

Q – R means ‘Q is the father of R’

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e4bdbb3564cda64ba097df139137679be8f18499fec9212a263d4c08fbb5d076.png] 

P is the aunt of R.

**Option 3**: P ÷ Q × P

P ÷ Q means ‘P is the brother of Q’.

Q × R means ‘Q is the sister of R’

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0a1991ac21899dc6bbddaf9d05ef0badd263a9b8b3720b5be77b538bc4788f32.png] 

Here, P is the brother of R.

**Option 4 : **P ÷ Q – R

P ÷ Q means ‘P is the bother of Q’.

Q – R means ‘Q is the Father of R’

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a56891dbaa847439bca6b9e5a734debb740290c272b2a5b98500673665ba66a7.png] 

Here, P is the paternal uncle of R.

Hence, **'Option 1'** is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Select the option that is related to the third word in the same way as the second word is related to the first word. (The words must be considered as meaningful English words and must not be related to each other based on the number of letters / number of consonants / vowels in the word)

Cells ∶ Tissue ∶∶ Organs ∶ ?
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

Cells **make up tissues.**

Organs **make up Body.**

**A tissue is** a group of cells that share morphological features and perform similar functions.

**An organ** is a group of tissues that make up a functional unit that is specialized to execute specific functions within the body.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Kidney is made up of nephrons which is a flitter element.
 
• Lungs are made up of lobs and many air sacks.
 
• Heart is made up of three layer of tissue .

Hence,** **the correct answer is **Option (3)**.

questions.question: In the following question, four number pairs are given. In each pair the number on left side of (–) is related to the number of the right side of (–) with some Logic / Rule / Relation. Three pairs are similar on basis of same Logic / Rule / Relation. Select the odd one out from the given alternatives. (NOTE: Operations should be performed on the whole numbers, without breaking down the numbers into its constituent digits. E.g. 13 – Operations on 13 such as adding / subtracting / multiplying etc. to 13 can be performed. Breaking down 13 into 1 and 3 and then performing mathematical operations on 1 and 3 is not allowed)
questions.solution:
The logic follows here is:

**(Left side Number)² - 2 = Right side Number**

Apply logic on each options,

**Option 1: **12 – 142

(12)² - 2 = 144 - 2 = 142

Option 2: 8 – 62

(8)2 - 2 = 64 - 2 = 62

Option 3: 4 – 14

(4)2 - 2 = 16 - 2 = 14

Option 4: 14 – 192

(14)2 - 2 = 196 - 2 = 194

here in option 4, left side number not equal to right number.

Hence, **'option 4'** is the correct answer.
